changes: Original Go html/template really renders layout.html, unread_entries.html, starred_entries.html, history_entries.html, entry.html, item_meta.html and pagination.html using three fictional original Chinese articles. No manually redrawn templates or service required.

Go1.25.4 official archive installed only in private toolchain, SHA256 checked against official go.dev release JSON. Local renderer defines deterministic fixture formatting/translation/URL helpers; Go engine preserves original conditions and layout. This renderer is build-time only, not a browser dependency.

Original Chinese locale, system.css/common.css, complete original Tabler SVG sprite retained. icon helper changes external sprite URL to same-document #id for offline SVG use; all SVG elements/attributes safety checked. No packaged binary/fonts/media.

Original KeyboardHandler and 11 unchanged app.js selection/state/icon/scroll helpers retained; service calls and original bootstrap/ServiceWorker/storage/WebAuthn are not bundled. Explicit local controller maps navigation and read/star state to memory, never fake POST/sync success.

Static original list/history/starred pages rendered with fixture, then local DOM filtering mirrors current memory; original full entry text and additional-tags details preserved. Empty list pages use original empty branches. Feed icons ID0 and enclosure array empty are native optional branches, not removed core image placeholders.

Service-only buttons rendered by original template remain disabled with explanation; corresponding forms have no action and are prevented. External/feed/category/search/settings paths are visibly disabled, no fake full site. Original keyboard help dialog excluded because most listed backend shortcuts are not offered.

Runtime view navigation uses generated original body markup. Build strips resource links/scripts/meta service plumbing before bundling. Exit and rerender remove old anchor hrefs/disable controls; document.onkeydown restored, original keyboard queue cleared, hidden shortcuts suspended.

Original modern nested CSS/@view-transition retained. JSDOM exact CSS-parser diagnostic is excluded in behavior tests, not JavaScript errors; esbuild separately parses full CSS. Real pixels and browser CSS/layout not visually verified.
runtimeDependencies: No npm runtime package. Original Miniflux Apache-2.0 JS helpers and Tabler MIT SVG only. Go/esbuild/JSDOM are local build/test tools, not published runtime.
publication: 7 runtime/docs/license files; complete build/source/tests local, no uploaded archive claimed.
